title: Synthetic Data Generation & Multi-Step RL for Reasoning & Tool Use
authors_zh: Anna Goldie, Azalia Mirhoseini, Hao Zhou, Irene Cai, Christopher D. Manning
paper_type_zh: 工具使用轨迹构造与离线逐步强化学习方法
best_for_zh: 研究智能体轨迹、过程筛选、逐步奖励和离线 RL 的读者
one_line: SWiRL trains Gemma 2 from fixed search/calculator trajectories by turning every action and its full prefix into a reward-bearing RL sample; the recipe and prompts are public, but the trajectories, reward logs, implementation, and checkpoints are not.
SWiRL 将离线搜索/计算器完整轨迹拆为动作结束的前缀子轨迹，以 Gemini 1.5 Pro 过程筛选和逐动作生成式奖励训练 Gemma 2；方法与提示公开，但轨迹、奖励日志、代码和模型未发布。
why: It makes the supervision boundary explicit: a full tool-use episode is the source object, yet optimization consumes overlapping action-prefix subtrajectories with model-judged scalar feedback. That distinction is essential for auditing sample weighting, process-label quality, incorrect-outcome retention, and replayability.
inclusion_reason: SWiRL exposes a concrete post-training data transformation that is easy to lose in a title-only entry: multi-step tool trajectories become action-ending prefix subtrajectories, receive model-based process selection and per-action rewards, and enter offline policy-gradient training. It belongs as a training recipe and trajectory-feedback contract, not as a benchmark.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official OpenReview version is published as a conference paper at COLM 2025; arXiv:2504.04736 v2 is dated 28 April 2025. The paper asks how an autoregressive language-model policy can learn from multi-step reasoning and tool interaction when a conventional single-response RL objective supplies no explicit training signal for the intermediate actions. Its intervention is a construction-and-training recipe, not a new benchmark and not a verified public data release. (Paper p.1; §1, pp.1–2; §2, pp.3–5)

The source object is a complete trajectory tau=(s1,a1,...,sK,aK). s1 is the task prompt; each later state contains the full preceding context, including the prior model action and tool response; an action may contain chain-of-thought and a tagged search/calculator call or the tagged final answer. A K-action trajectory is then converted into K action-ending prefix subtrajectories, so the object consumed by the primary optimizer differs from the episode originally generated. (Paper §2.1, pp.3–4; §2.2, pp.4–5; Figure 2)

This object supports environment_agent_trajectory_data because search and calculator observations become part of the replayed state, and training_usage_optimization_objectives because SWiRL attaches model-based reward to every action prefix for offline RL. The paper also evaluates SFT on the synthetic trajectories, but SFT is a comparison rather than the principal method; HotPotQA, GSM8K, CofCA, MuSiQue, and BeerQA are evaluation surfaces rather than a benchmark released by SWiRL. (Paper §2; §4; Appendix C)

The Card reaches bilingual research-review depth from the full COLM paper and Appendices A–F: task pools, prompts, trajectory schema, filters, tools, reported results, and several evaluation IDs are described. Reuse remains blocked because no official trajectory corpus, per-step labels or rewards, implementation, vector index, checkpoint, or artifact license was verified.

OpenReview 官方版本标明该论文发表于 COLM 2025；arXiv:2504.04736 v2 的日期为 2025 年 4 月 28 日。论文要解决的问题是：当传统单回答 RL 目标不为中间动作提供显式训练信号时，如何让自回归语言模型 policy 从多步推理与工具交互中学习。它的实际贡献是数据构造与训练 recipe，不是新 benchmark，也不是已核验的公开数据发布。（论文 p.1；§1，pp.1–2；§2，pp.3–5）

源数据对象是一条完整轨迹 tau=(s1,a1,...,sK,aK)。s1 为任务 prompt；后续每个 state 包含此前的完整上下文，包括上一模型动作及工具响应；动作可包含 chain-of-thought 与带标签的搜索/计算器调用，或带标签的最终答案。一条含 K 个动作的轨迹随后被转换为 K 条以动作结束的前缀子轨迹，因此主优化器消费的数据对象不同于最初生成的完整 episode。（论文 §2.1，pp.3–4；§2.2，pp.4–5；Figure 2）

该对象属于 environment_agent_trajectory_data，因为搜索与计算器 observation 被写入可回放 state；同时属于 training_usage_optimization_objectives，因为 SWiRL 在离线 RL 中给每个动作前缀附加模型奖励。论文也在同一组合成轨迹上比较 SFT，但 SFT 不是主方法；HotPotQA、GSM8K、CofCA、MuSiQue 与 BeerQA 是评测面，不是 SWiRL 发布的 benchmark。（论文 §2；§4；Appendix C）

本卡依据完整 COLM 论文与 Appendices A–F 达到双语研究审阅深度：任务池、prompt、轨迹 schema、筛选器、工具、实验结果及若干评测 ID 均有披露。复用仍被阻塞，因为未核验到官方轨迹语料、逐步标签或奖励、实现、向量索引、checkpoint 或工件许可证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SWiRL's central move is to turn a fixed, full search/calculator trajectory into one training state per action: prefix s supplies all earlier actions and tool observations, the final action a is the optimized response, and a generative reward model supplies R(a|s). The same Gemma 2 policy first generates the trajectories and is then finetuned on this offline decomposition. (Paper §2 opening; §2.2, p.5; Figures 1–2)

There are two distinct feedback stages. During synthetic-data selection, Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking labels the current action GOOD or BAD given its preceding context; process-only selection retains a full trajectory only if every action is GOOD. A separate outcome filter asks a model judge whether the final answer matches the golden answer and returns YES/NO. During stage-2 SWiRL optimization, Gemini 1.5 Pro instead acts as a generative reward model for each action prefix without receiving golden answers. The paper does not disclose that reward prompt, scalar mapping, normalization, or calibration, so the stage-2 reward must not be represented as the Appendix A binary process filter. (Paper §2.1, p.4; §2.2, p.5; Appendix A, pp.21–22)

The feedback can observe the serialized context, current response, and stored tool result. It cannot by itself establish that retrieved evidence is true or uncontaminated, that the search corpus is correctly versioned, or that a plausible intermediate action will produce a correct terminal answer. The environment contributes observations—Gecko-1B vector retrieval for QA and SymPy execution for math—but success selection and RL reward remain model judgments, hence the mixed verification contract. (Paper §2.3, p.5; Appendix A)

Relative to DQO and OREO, the paper emphasizes offline tool-use training with action-level/subtrajectory reward and no separately trained value network. Relative to STaR, RFT, and ReST-style synthetic training, it tests process-based retention—including trajectories with incorrect final outcomes—and step-wise RL rather than relying only on correct-outcome SFT. These ingredients have prior art individually; the contribution is their combined data/feedback interface for multi-step tool use. (Paper §3, pp.5–7; §4.2, pp.8–9)

SWiRL 的核心变化，是把固定的完整搜索/计算器轨迹转换成逐动作训练 state：前缀 s 提供此前全部动作与工具 observation，末尾动作 a 是被优化的响应，generative reward model 提供 R(a|s)。同一个 Gemma 2 policy 先生成轨迹，再在这套离线分解上 finetune。（论文 §2 开头；§2.2，p.5；Figures 1–2）

这里存在两个不同的反馈阶段。合成数据筛选时，Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking 根据此前上下文把当前动作标为 GOOD 或 BAD；process-only 筛选仅在每个动作都为 GOOD 时保留整条轨迹。另一个 outcome filter 让模型 judge 判断最终答案是否匹配 golden answer，并输出 YES/NO。stage-2 SWiRL 优化时，Gemini 1.5 Pro 则在不接收 golden answer 的条件下，为每个动作前缀充当 generative reward model。论文没有披露其 reward prompt、标量映射、归一化或校准，因此不能把 stage-2 reward 写成 Appendix A 的二元过程筛选器。（论文 §2.1，p.4；§2.2，p.5；Appendix A，pp.21–22）

该反馈可以观察序列化上下文、当前响应和已保存工具结果，但无法自行确认检索证据是否真实或无污染、搜索语料是否被正确固定版本，也不能保证看似合理的中间动作最终得到正确答案。环境提供 observation——QA 使用 Gecko-1B 向量检索，数学使用 SymPy 执行——但成功筛选与 RL reward 仍是模型判断，因此 verification contract 为 mixed。（论文 §2.3，p.5；Appendix A）

相较 DQO 与 OREO，论文强调使用动作级/子轨迹奖励进行离线工具使用训练，且不另行训练 value network；相较 STaR、RFT 与 ReST 式合成训练，它测试基于过程的保留——包括最终答案错误的轨迹——以及 step-wise RL，而不只依赖正确结果 SFT。各组件本身都有先例；贡献在于把它们组合成面向多步工具使用的数据/反馈接口。（论文 §3，pp.5–7；§4.2，pp.8–9）

title: Method
方法
html:
Inputs and generation. The QA pool contains 10,000 non-Easy HotPotQA training questions; five Gemma 2 rollouts per question produce 50,000 search trajectories. The math pool contains 7,500 GSM8K training questions and 37,500 calculator trajectories. The generator is the same Gemma 2 policy later finetuned; Gemma 2 27B is the main setting, with 2B and 9B ablations. Exact model revisions, temperature, top-p, seeds, and retry rules are unknown. (Paper §2.1, pp.3–4; Appendix B)

Interaction substrate. At each step the policy emits reasoning plus a tagged tool call or a final answer. QA search queries are embedded by Gecko-1B into 768-dimensional English vectors and matched by nearest-neighbor lookup against articles from the relevant split. Tagged mathematical expressions are executed by SymPy and the result is appended to context. Generation stops at the tagged final-answer marker or the cap of 5 steps for HotPotQA and 10 for GSM8K; malformed-tag and tool-exception behavior is not disclosed. (Paper §2.1, pp.3–4; §2.3, p.5; Appendix A; Appendix E)

Selection. Four trajectory pools are compared: unfiltered; process-only; outcome-only; and the intersection. Process filtering asks Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking for a GOOD/BAD decision at every action and keeps the full trajectory only if every action is GOOD. Outcome filtering uses a separate search- or calculator-specific prompt to compare the final answer with the golden answer and require YES. Exact retained counts, judge retries, ties, and failure logs are unknown. (Paper §2.1, p.4; Figure 1; Appendix A, pp.21–22)

Action-prefix transformation and reward. For each retained tau=(s1,a1,...,sK,aK), SWiRL emits K overlapping subtrajectories ending at a1 through aK. Optimization samples prefix state s, produces current action a, and maximizes J(theta)=E[R(a|s)], with rewards summed step-wise. Gemini 1.5 Pro supplies this generative action reward without golden answers. The paper says offline finetuning uses the same policy-gradient algorithm as Gemma 2's human-feedback reward optimization, but does not name the algorithm or report optimizer, learning rate, batch sizes, epochs, KL/reference policy, sequence lengths, hardware, compute, seeds, or checkpoint selection. (Paper §2.2, pp.4–5; Figure 2)

Outputs and uses. The principal output is a finetuned Gemma 2 tool-use policy learned from fixed action-prefix records. Appendix C uses the same synthetic trajectory pools for an SFT comparison; this supports SFT as a studied use, not as SWiRL's main objective. Agent/tool training and evaluation are also demonstrated, but the paper does not release a benchmark. (Paper §4; Appendix C)

Split and replay boundary. HotPotQA-train and GSM8K-train seed training, while HotPotQA and GSM8K also appear as evaluation tasks and CofCA, MuSiQue, and BeerQA test transfer. Appendix F publishes the 300-item HotPotQA, CofCA, and MuSiQue evaluation IDs, not GSM8K/BeerQA IDs or a training manifest. A reproduction must pin source revisions, question IDs, Gemma/Gemini snapshots, prompts, retrieval corpus and index, Gecko-1B, SymPy/Python, tool outputs, filters, action-prefix weighting, reward mapping, optimizer, and evaluation judges; most of these are not publicly pinned.

输入与生成。 QA 池包含 10,000 个非 Easy 的 HotPotQA 训练问题；每题生成 5 条 Gemma 2 rollout，共得到 50,000 条搜索轨迹。数学池包含 7,500 个 GSM8K 训练问题与 37,500 条计算器轨迹。generator 是随后接受 finetune 的同一个 Gemma 2 policy；主设置为 Gemma 2 27B，另有 2B 与 9B 消融。精确模型版本、temperature、top-p、seed 与重试规则均为 unknown。（论文 §2.1，pp.3–4；Appendix B）

交互环境。 每一步 policy 输出推理以及带标签的工具调用，或输出最终答案。QA 搜索 query 由 Gecko-1B 编码为 768 维英文向量，再针对相关 split 的文章做 nearest-neighbor 查询；带标签的数学表达式由 SymPy 执行，结果追加到上下文。生成在出现带标签的最终答案标记时结束，HotPotQA 上限 5 步、GSM8K 上限 10 步；错误标签和工具异常的处理方式未披露。（论文 §2.1，pp.3–4；§2.3，p.5；Appendix A；Appendix E）

筛选。 论文比较四种轨迹池：无筛选、仅过程、仅结果、过程与结果的交集。过程筛选让 Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking 对每个动作输出 GOOD/BAD，只有全部动作为 GOOD 才保留完整轨迹。结果筛选使用搜索任务或计算器任务专用 prompt，把最终答案与 golden answer 比较，并要求输出 YES。精确保留量、judge 重试、并列处理和失败日志均为 unknown。（论文 §2.1，p.4；Figure 1；Appendix A，pp.21–22）

动作前缀转换与奖励。 对每条保留的 tau=(s1,a1,...,sK,aK)，SWiRL 产生 K 条相互重叠、分别结束于 a1 到 aK 的子轨迹。优化时采样前缀 state s，生成当前动作 a，最大化 J(theta)=E[R(a|s)]，并按步骤累加 reward。Gemini 1.5 Pro 在没有 golden answer 的条件下提供该生成式动作奖励。论文称离线 finetuning 使用与 Gemma 2 人类反馈奖励优化相同的 policy-gradient 算法，但没有给出算法名称、optimizer、learning rate、batch size、epoch、KL/reference policy、序列长度、硬件、计算量、seed 或 checkpoint 选择。（论文 §2.2，pp.4–5；Figure 2）

输出与用途。 主输出是从固定动作前缀记录学习得到的 Gemma 2 工具使用 policy。Appendix C 使用同一组合成轨迹池进行 SFT 对比；这支持把 SFT 记作已研究用途，但它不是 SWiRL 的主目标。论文也展示了 agent/工具训练与评测用途，但没有发布 benchmark。（论文 §4；Appendix C）

划分与回放边界。 HotPotQA-train 与 GSM8K-train 用于生成训练数据，同时 HotPotQA 与 GSM8K 也作为评测任务；CofCA、MuSiQue、BeerQA 用于迁移评测。Appendix F 公布了 300 条 HotPotQA、CofCA 与 MuSiQue 的评测 ID，但没有 GSM8K/BeerQA ID 或训练 manifest。复现需要固定数据源版本与问题 ID、Gemma/Gemini snapshot、prompt、检索语料与索引、Gecko-1B、SymPy/Python、工具输出、筛选器、动作前缀加权、reward 映射、optimizer 及评测 judge；其中大多数没有公开固定。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Table 1 evaluates process-filtered HotPotQA SWiRL with Gemma 2 27B, retrieval access, and GPT-4o judging on 300 randomly subsampled examples per dataset. It reports HotPotQA accuracy 67.8 versus 58.6 for base Gemma 2 27B, CofCA 39.3 versus 31.7, and MuSiQue 43.6 versus 35.4. The named comparison rows from prior work are imported from Wu et al. (2024); these are author-reported results, not an independent reproduction. (Paper Table 1 and caption, pp.7–8)

The cross-task study uses a different 300-item subsample and reports base [.65, .65, .54, .59, .45], SWiRL trained on GSM8K [.79, .71, .56, .68, .49], and SWiRL trained on HotPotQA [.76, .73, .62, .68, .50] over GSM8K, HotPotQA, CofCA, BeerQA, and MuSiQue respectively. This supports cross-task transfer under the paper's judge and sampling setup; it does not identify whether gains come from unique data, repeated prefixes, the reward model, or optimizer details that were not disclosed. (Paper Table 2, p.9)

The filter ablation is especially relevant to the data claim. For SWiRL, process-only trajectories perform best and intentionally include both correct and incorrect terminal outcomes; outcome-only filtering is generally worse than even no filtering, except on MuSiQue. Appendix C reverses the local preference for SFT: process-plus-outcome filtering is better than process-only, while SFT remains below SWiRL across the filtering strategies. This is evidence that selection interacts with the objective, not proof that process labels are intrinsically high quality. (Paper §4.2 and Figure 4, pp.8–9; Appendix C, Figure 8, p.24)

Scaling evidence is bounded. Figure 6 reports that 100 HotPotQA trajectories do not generalize robustly, 1,000 show gains, and 10,000 improve further. Appendix B reports that Gemma 2 2B and 9B improve in-domain but have mixed out-of-domain behavior, whereas 27B improves consistently across the tested QA datasets. These are qualitative figure trends over one recipe, not a general scaling law. (Paper §4.2, pp.9–10; Appendix B, Figure 7, p.23)

For a process-label analysis of 500 trajectories from 100 questions, Table 3 reports HotPotQA 82.5% to 91.0% and GSM8K 87.5% to 91.6%, macro-averaged within and across trajectories. Appendix D's separate 100-example judge audit finds HotPotQA false-positive/false-negative rates of 4%/1% for Gemma 2 27B; on GSM8K it reports 15%/0% for Gemma 2 27B, 0%/10% for GPT-4o, and 4%/0% for Gemini 1.5 Pro, with cited errors involving units. Small calibration samples and judge reuse across filtering, reward, and evaluation leave correlated-error risk. (Paper Table 3, p.10; Appendix D, Tables 4–5, p.25)

All numbers above establish only the reported experimental behavior. They do not certify record-level trajectory correctness, reward calibration, contamination control, license compatibility, or the quality of an unreleased corpus.

Table 1 评测使用 process-only HotPotQA 数据训练的 SWiRL，模型为 Gemma 2 27B，允许检索，并在每个数据集随机抽取 300 条由 GPT-4o 评分。论文报告 HotPotQA 准确率为 67.8，而 base Gemma 2 27B 为 58.6；CofCA 为 39.3 对 31.7；MuSiQue 为 43.6 对 35.4。表中具名既有方法结果引自 Wu et al. (2024)；这些都是作者报告结果，不是独立复现。（论文 Table 1 及 caption，pp.7–8）

跨任务研究使用另一组 300 条子样本，并依次在 GSM8K、HotPotQA、CofCA、BeerQA 与 MuSiQue 上报告：base 为 [.65, .65, .54, .59, .45]，在 GSM8K 上训练的 SWiRL 为 [.79, .71, .56, .68, .49]，在 HotPotQA 上训练的 SWiRL 为 [.76, .73, .62, .68, .50]。这支持论文 judge 与采样设置下的跨任务迁移，但无法区分增益究竟来自独立数据、重复前缀、reward model，还是未披露的 optimizer 细节。（论文 Table 2，p.9）

筛选消融对数据结论尤其重要。在 SWiRL 中，process-only 轨迹效果最好，而且会有意保留最终结果正确与错误的两类轨迹；除 MuSiQue 外，outcome-only 筛选通常甚至不如不筛选。Appendix C 中 SFT 的局部偏好相反：过程与结果交集优于 process-only，但各筛选策略下 SFT 仍低于 SWiRL。这说明筛选方式与训练目标存在交互，不证明过程标签天然高质量。（论文 §4.2 与 Figure 4，pp.8–9；Appendix C，Figure 8，p.24）

规模证据有明确边界。Figure 6 报告 100 条 HotPotQA 轨迹不足以稳健泛化，1,000 条开始出现增益，10,000 条进一步提升。Appendix B 报告 Gemma 2 2B 与 9B 在域内提升、域外表现不稳定，而 27B 在所测 QA 数据集上一致提升。这只是单一 recipe 的定性图表趋势，不是一般性 scaling law。（论文 §4.2，pp.9–10；Appendix B，Figure 7，p.23）

在由 100 个问题生成的 500 条轨迹上，Table 3 的过程标签分析报告：HotPotQA 从 82.5% 提升到 91.0%，GSM8K 从 87.5% 提升到 91.6%，指标在轨迹内和轨迹间做 macro-average。Appendix D 另在 100 条样本上审计 judge：Gemma 2 27B 在 HotPotQA 的 FPR/FNR 为 4%/1%；在 GSM8K 上，Gemma 2 27B 为 15%/0%，GPT-4o 为 0%/10%，Gemini 1.5 Pro 为 4%/0%，所列错误均涉及单位。小规模校准样本，加上 judge 在筛选、奖励和评测中的复用，仍存在相关误差风险。（论文 Table 3，p.10；Appendix D，Tables 4–5，p.25）

以上数字只建立论文报告的实验行为，不能认证逐条轨迹正确性、reward 校准、污染控制、许可证兼容性或未发布语料的质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is not a benchmark but a family of training recipes. STaR, RFT, and ReST-style methods generate or reuse model outputs and commonly select successful outcomes for supervised improvement. DQO and OREO address offline multi-step RL, including value-oriented machinery. The paper positions SWiRL against both families. (Paper §3, pp.5–7)

What changes is the interface between trajectory data and optimization: a complete tool-use episode is selected as a unit, then serialized into one overlapping prefix record per action; a generative reward model scores the action conditioned on that prefix, and the fixed records enter offline policy-gradient training without a separately trained value network. Stage-1 process selection may retain an incorrect final answer if every action is judged reasonable, while stage-2 reward uses no golden answer. This separates process quality, outcome correctness, and optimization feedback instead of collapsing them into one label. (Paper §2; Figures 1–2)

The directional value for reasoning-data research is this explicit change of supervision boundary. It permits objective-specific questions about prefix duplication, long-trajectory weighting, stored environment observations, process false positives, and whether incorrect outcomes help or harm step-wise RL. The comparison with Appendix C also shows that the preferred filter depends on whether trajectories enter SFT or RL. (Paper §4.2; Appendix C)

What is not new includes synthetic self-generation, search/calculator tool calls, LLM judging, outcome filtering against golden answers, SFT, and policy-gradient optimization. The reported scale and benchmark accuracy do not make the hidden trajectories a data release. Reuse requires official records, filter and reward outputs, environment versions, objective configuration, lineage, and licenses before the recipe can become a training artifact.

最接近的比较对象不是 benchmark，而是多类训练 recipe。STaR、RFT 与 ReST 式方法生成或复用模型输出，并通常选择成功结果做监督式改进；DQO 与 OREO 则处理离线多步 RL，包括面向 value 的机制。论文把 SWiRL 同时置于这两类工作之间比较。（论文 §3，pp.5–7）

真正改变的是轨迹数据与优化之间的接口：完整工具使用 episode 先作为整体被筛选，再序列化为每个动作一条、相互重叠的前缀记录；generative reward model 根据该前缀给动作评分，固定记录进入无需单独 value network 的离线 policy-gradient 训练。stage-1 过程筛选可在所有动作被判为合理时保留最终答案错误的轨迹，而 stage-2 reward 不使用 golden answer。这把过程质量、结果正确性与优化反馈分成三个层次，而不是压缩成一个标签。（论文 §2；Figures 1–2）

对 reasoning data 研究而言，其方向价值在于明确改变了监督边界，从而可以逐项审计前缀重复、长轨迹加权、存储式环境 observation、过程 false positive，以及错误结果对 step-wise RL 究竟有益还是有害。与 Appendix C 的对比还表明，同一轨迹进入 SFT 或 RL 时，最合适的筛选器并不相同。（论文 §4.2；Appendix C）

不属于新贡献的组件包括合成自生成、搜索/计算器工具调用、LLM judge、依据 golden answer 的结果筛选、SFT 与 policy-gradient 优化。报告的数据规模和 benchmark 准确率也不会把隐藏轨迹变成数据发布。只有在官方记录、筛选与 reward 输出、环境版本、目标配置、lineage 和许可证齐备后，该 recipe 才可能成为可复用训练工件。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Process-filter error. Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking judges whether an action is reasonable in context, not whether retrieved evidence is true, complete, current, or uncontaminated. A false positive can retain a plausible-looking wrong search step or final answer; process-only selection explicitly keeps some incorrect outcomes. (Paper §2.1; Appendix A)
  • Reward opacity and gaming. The stage-2 generative reward prompt, scalar range, normalization, decoding, calibration, and model snapshot are undisclosed. This blocks reconstruction of what the policy maximizes and leaves reward hacking or verbosity/style preference unmeasured.
  • Correlated judge roles. Gemini 1.5 Pro participates in process filtering, RL reward, GSM8K evaluation, and process-label analysis. Improvements measured with related model judgments can share blind spots; Appendix D's 100-example checks do not audit process-filter errors or reward overoptimization. (Paper §4.1; Appendix D)
  • Prefix weighting is unspecified. Converting a K-action trajectory into K samples repeats long contexts and gives longer episodes more optimization records. It is a curator inference that this can reweight examples; the paper discloses no deduplication, per-trajectory normalization, or weighting rule that resolves the risk.
  • Environment drift. QA depends on an unreleased article corpus snapshot, Gecko-1B checkpoint, index configuration, retrieval depth, and stored search results; math depends on undisclosed SymPy/Python versions and exception handling. Offline prefixes may therefore replay text while failing to reproduce the original environment behavior.
  • Split and contamination. HotPotQA and GSM8K training questions seed the synthetic pool and also define in-domain evaluation surfaces. Exact revisions, source/evaluation ID maps, semantic deduplication, pretraining contamination, and retrieval-corpus answer leakage are not audited.
  • Release and rights. No official code, synthetic trajectories, filter labels, rewards, retained/rejected manifest, vector index, configuration, checkpoint, or model/data license was verified. CC BY 4.0 covers the arXiv paper, not these absent artifacts or upstream retrieved text.
  • Generalization and reproduction. Results come from author experiments on a bounded task family and often 300-item subsets. Smaller Gemma models show mixed out-of-domain results, optimizer details are missing, and no independent reproduction package is available. (Paper §4; Appendices B and F)

• 过程筛选误差。 Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking 判断动作在上下文中是否合理，并不判断检索证据是否真实、完整、最新或无污染。false positive 可能保留看似合理但错误的搜索步骤或最终答案；process-only 筛选本就明确保留一部分错误结果。（论文 §2.1；Appendix A）
  • 奖励不透明与 gaming。 stage-2 generative reward 的 prompt、标量范围、归一化、解码、校准与模型 snapshot 均未披露。这阻碍对 policy 实际优化对象的重建，也使 reward hacking 或对冗长/风格的偏好未被测量。
  • Judge 角色相关。 Gemini 1.5 Pro 同时参与过程筛选、RL reward、GSM8K 评测与过程标签分析。由相关模型判断测得的改进可能共享盲点；Appendix D 的 100 条检查没有覆盖过程筛选误差或 reward 过优化。（论文 §4.1；Appendix D）
  • 前缀加权未说明。 把含 K 个动作的轨迹转换成 K 条样本会重复长上下文，并让较长 episode 获得更多优化记录。“这可能重加权样本”是 curator inference；论文没有披露能化解该风险的去重、逐轨迹归一化或加权规则。
  • 环境漂移。 QA 依赖未发布的文章语料 snapshot、Gecko-1B checkpoint、索引配置、检索深度和已保存搜索结果；数学依赖未披露的 SymPy/Python 版本与异常处理。离线前缀因此可能重放文本，却无法复现原始环境行为。
  • 划分与污染。 HotPotQA 与 GSM8K 的训练问题既生成合成池，也定义域内评测面。精确版本、训练/评测 ID 映射、语义去重、预训练污染与检索语料答案泄漏均未审计。
  • 发布与权利。 未核验到官方代码、合成轨迹、筛选标签、reward、保留/拒绝 manifest、向量索引、配置、checkpoint 或模型/数据许可证。CC BY 4.0 覆盖 arXiv 论文，不覆盖这些缺失工件或上游检索文本。
  • 泛化与复现。 结果来自作者在有限任务族上的实验，且常使用 300 条子集。较小 Gemma 模型的域外结果不稳定，optimizer 细节缺失，也没有独立复现包。（论文 §4；Appendices B 与 F）

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For environment_agent_trajectory_data, SWiRL is a concrete construction reference for serializing tool behavior: preserve the source question, full state prefix, model reasoning/action, structured tool call, tool response, final answer, terminal reason, filter decisions, and the link from each action-ending subtrajectory back to its full episode. A reproduction should retain successful, incorrect-outcome, malformed, and rejected trajectories rather than only the final accepted pool.

For training_usage_optimization_objectives, the useful baseline separates three consumers of the same source episode: SFT on synthetic trajectories as the Appendix C comparison; stage-1 process/outcome selection; and offline step-wise RL on reward-bearing action prefixes as the principal method. An ablation should hold generator, trajectory pool, environment responses, judge versions, and budget fixed while changing the filter or objective, because the paper shows that process-only is preferred for SWiRL whereas process-plus-outcome is preferred for SFT.

The paper can guide process-supervision and agent-training experiments in search or calculator environments. It also supplies an evaluation/audit checklist: distinguish environmental observations from learned judgments; calibrate process, outcome, reward, and evaluation judges separately; measure incorrect-outcome retention; test alternative judges; and report weighting induced by prefix decomposition. Table 1–3, Figure 4, and Appendices B–F are the relevant experimental references, not evidence that a reusable corpus exists.

Reuse class: reading/audit and construction-recipe reference only; direct training reuse is blocked pending verification. To unblock it, an official package would need immutable source/split manifests, trajectories and failed generations, tool-response snapshots, per-step process labels and rewards, exact model/prompt versions, reward mapping, optimizer configuration, checkpoints, record-level lineage, contamination analysis, and compatible licenses. The work is not safe to reuse as a benchmark because SWiRL does not release one.

对 environment_agent_trajectory_data 而言，SWiRL 是一个具体的工具行为序列化构造参考：应保留源问题、完整 state 前缀、模型推理/动作、结构化工具调用、工具响应、最终答案、terminal reason、筛选决策，以及每条动作结束子轨迹到完整 episode 的关联。复现还应保留成功轨迹、错误结果轨迹、格式错误轨迹与被拒轨迹，而不是只留下最终接受池。

对 training_usage_optimization_objectives 而言，有用的 baseline 应区分同一源 episode 的三类消费者：Appendix C 对比中的合成轨迹 SFT；stage-1 过程/结果筛选；以及主方法中对带 reward 动作前缀进行的离线 step-wise RL。由于论文显示 SWiRL 偏好 process-only、SFT 偏好过程与结果交集，消融实验应固定 generator、轨迹池、环境响应、judge 版本与预算，只改变筛选器或训练目标。

论文可指导搜索或计算器环境中的过程监督与 agent training 实验，也提供一份评测/审计清单：分开环境 observation 与学习式判断；分别校准过程、结果、reward 与评测 judge；测量错误结果保留；测试替代 judge；报告前缀分解引入的加权。Table 1–3、Figure 4 与 Appendices B–F 是相关实验依据，但不是存在可复用语料的证据。

复用等级：仅限阅读/审计与构造 recipe 参考；直接训练复用在完成核验前被阻塞。要解除阻塞，官方包需提供不可变数据源/split manifest、轨迹与失败生成、工具响应 snapshot、逐步过程标签与 reward、精确模型/prompt 版本、reward 映射、optimizer 配置、checkpoint、逐记录 lineage、污染分析及兼容许可证。该工作也不能作为 benchmark 安全复用，因为 SWiRL 没有发布 benchmark。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Do not index SWiRL as a benchmark: its contribution is a synthetic trajectory construction, selection, and offline step-wise RL recipe; no SWiRL benchmark or official corpus release was verified.
  • Keep the two data units separate: the generated object is a complete search/calculator trajectory, while the primary optimizer consumes one overlapping prefix subtrajectory per action. Read §2 and Figure 2 first.
  • Keep the two Gemini roles separate: Appendix A's stage-1 GOOD/BAD process filter selects trajectories; §2.2's stage-2 generative action reward has no golden answer and an undisclosed prompt/scale.
  • Read Figure 4 with Appendix C: process-only is best for SWiRL and retains incorrect outcomes, whereas process-plus-outcome is best for the SFT comparison. Filter quality is objective-dependent.
  • Before reuse, verify trajectories, rejected samples, rewards, reward mapping, model/tool/index versions, optimizer settings, split/overlap controls, lineage, and licenses; all remain unavailable or unknown.

• 不要把 SWiRL 编入 benchmark：其贡献是合成轨迹构造、筛选与离线 step-wise RL recipe；未核验到 SWiRL benchmark 或官方语料发布。
  • 必须区分两种数据单元：生成对象是完整搜索/计算器轨迹，主优化器消费的是每个动作一条、相互重叠的前缀子轨迹。优先阅读 §2 与 Figure 2。
  • 必须区分 Gemini 的两个角色：Appendix A 中 stage-1 的 GOOD/BAD 过程筛选用于选择轨迹；§2.2 中 stage-2 的生成式动作 reward 不使用 golden answer，且 prompt/标度未披露。
  • 应把 Figure 4 与 Appendix C 对照阅读：process-only 对 SWiRL 最好并保留错误结果，而过程与结果交集对 SFT 对比最好；筛选质量取决于训练目标。
  • 复用前必须核验轨迹、拒绝样本、reward、reward 映射、模型/工具/索引版本、optimizer 设置、划分/重叠控制、lineage 与许可证；这些项目仍不可用或为 unknown。

value.html: Two paper-reported training pools: 10,000 non-Easy HotPotQA training questions seed 50,000 search-tool trajectories, and all 7,500 GSM8K training questions seed 37,500 calculator trajectories. Exact seed IDs, revisions, and the HotPotQA Easy-filter implementation are not released.

A trajectory tau=(s1,a1,...,sK,aK) begins with the task prompt. Every later state contains the full preceding context, model action, and applicable tool response. Each action may include chain-of-thought plus one tagged search/calculator call, or the tagged final answer. A K-action trajectory is transformed into K action-ending prefix subtrajectories for step-wise optimization.

The Gemma 2 policy pi_theta generates the synthetic trajectories and is then finetuned by SWiRL; the main experiments use Gemma 2 27B and Appendix B studies 2B/9B variants. Exact model revisions and decoding configurations are unknown.

Question answering uses tagged search queries, Gecko-1B 768-dimensional English embeddings, and nearest-neighbor lookup over a vector database containing articles from the relevant split. Mathematics uses tagged expressions executed by SymPy. Tool responses are collected during offline trajectory generation and preserved in later subtrajectory prefixes.

Stage-1 process filtering asks Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking for binary GOOD/BAD judgments on the current action given its preceding context and retains trajectories only when every action is judged reasonable. A separate outcome filter uses golden-answer comparison. Stage-2 SWiRL instead uses Gemini 1.5 Pro as a generative reward model R(a|s) for each action conditioned on its prefix, without golden answers; the reward prompt, scale, normalization, and exact model snapshot are unknown. Evaluation uses GPT-4o for Table 1, Gemma 2 27B for most other tasks, and Gemini 1.5 Pro for GSM8K.

The episode ends when the model emits an <answer> tag; data generation caps trajectory length at 5 steps for HotPotQA and 10 for GSM8K, while evaluation caps tool queries at 5 for QA and 10 for math. Handling of malformed tags, tool exceptions, and other stop reasons is unknown.

HotPotQA-train or GSM8K-train question -> Gemma 2 multi-step tool rollout -> optional process/outcome filtering -> full trajectory tau -> one prefix subtrajectory per action -> Gemini 1.5 Pro action reward -> offline step-wise policy-gradient update. No released record-level manifest connects these stages.
Gemma 2; 27B is the main model, with 2B and 9B model-size ablations. Exact checkpoint revisions are unknown.
No separate teacher trajectory generator is reported. Gemini 1.5 Pro Thinking/Pro supplies process filtering and step-wise reward judgments, not target trajectories.
The same Gemma 2 policy pi_theta that is subsequently finetuned generates multi-step search or calculator trajectories through iterative prompting and tool execution.
10,000 non-Easy HotPotQA training questions and 7,500 GSM8K training questions. Appendix A provides the search/calculator generation, process-filter, and outcome-evaluation prompt templates.

Five synthetic trajectories per seed question are reported (explicit for HotPotQA and implied by 37,500/7,500 for GSM8K). Exact decoding temperature, top-p, random seeds, batching, and malformed-output retry policy are unknown.
unknown
unknown

Offline tool-augmented rollout collection followed by fixed-data RL: QA queries use a Gecko-1B vector index; math expressions use SymPy; each collected trajectory is decomposed into action-prefix subtrajectories.

Process-only requires all action judgments in a trajectory to be GOOD. Outcome-only requires a YES judgment against the golden answer. Exact post-filter counts and judge retry/tie policies are unknown.

Four controlled variants are compared: no filtering; process-only (every step receives GOOD); outcome-only (final answer matches the golden label); and their intersection. The best SWiRL condition is process-only and intentionally retains both correct and incorrect final outcomes.

Synthetic-data maximum trajectory length: 5 steps for HotPotQA and 10 for GSM8K. Evaluation permits up to 5 search queries for QA and 10 calculator queries for math. Token limits and wall-clock/tool-call budgets are unknown.

Offline step-wise policy-gradient optimization of E[R(a|s)] over action-prefix states, using the same policy-gradient algorithm as Gemma 2 human-feedback reward training. The exact algorithm, optimizer, learning rate, batch sizes, epochs, KL/reference settings, seeds, hardware, and compute are unknown.

HotPotQA and GSM8K training questions, Gemma 2-generated chain-of-thought/tool trajectories, vector-retrieved split articles or SymPy outputs, Gemini 1.5 Pro process/reward judgments, golden-answer outcome judgments, and action-prefix subtrajectory duplication.

Training sources are explicitly the HotPotQA training set and GSM8K training set. Evaluation covers HotPotQA, GSM8K, CofCA, MuSiQue, and BeerQA, often on 300-item subsamples. Appendix F publishes the HotPotQA, CofCA, and MuSiQue evaluation IDs, but exact dataset revisions, all split names, GSM8K/BeerQA IDs, and train/evaluation maps are unknown.

HotPotQA and GSM8K serve as both training-source tasks and evaluation surfaces; cross-task transfer is also measured on CofCA, MuSiQue, and BeerQA. No lexical/semantic deduplication, pretraining-contamination audit, or retrieval-corpus leakage analysis is disclosed.
unknown

Process-only filtering retains trajectories with both correct and incorrect final answers, while the other filter variants reject by process, outcome, or both. Exact retained/rejected counts, failed tool calls, malformed traces, and a successful/failed sample manifest are unknown and unreleased.

label: Verifier / judge failure modes
验证器与评审失效模式

items: The process filter evaluates whether the current query is likely to help or whether an answer follows retrieved results; it does not independently establish that the retrieved evidence is true, complete, current, or non-contaminated.
Gemini 1.5 Pro participates in filtering, RL reward, GSM8K outcome evaluation, and the process-label analysis, creating correlated-model measurement and reward-overoptimization risk.
The precise stage-2 reward prompt, scalar mapping, normalization, and calibration are undisclosed, so a reproducer cannot determine which behavior the optimizer actually maximizes.

Process-only filtering intentionally retains incorrect terminal answers. This increases useful negative/outcome diversity but can also reinforce a grounded-looking wrong answer when the process judge produces a false positive.
Appendix D finds judge sensitivity to units: on 100 GSM8K judgments, Gemma 2 27B is overly permissive (15% FPR), while GPT-4o is overly harsh (10% FNR); Gemini 1.5 Pro still has 4% FPR.

Converting every trajectory into one sample per action repeats long prefixes and gives longer trajectories more subtrajectory records; the paper does not disclose weighting or deduplication that would control this curator-inferred bias.
Offline stored tool responses improve throughput but hide environment/version drift unless vector corpora, indices, retrieval outputs, and SymPy behavior are pinned and released.

Results are reported from author experiments without a public implementation/checkpoint package or independent reproduction; optimizer and decoding changes could confound the data/filtering attribution.
